images.title: § 174A: R&D expensing *is back*.
images.sub: Same $2M of R&D. *+$378,000* less federal tax in year 1 – and your deferred taxes move.

images.title: What changed
images.text: 2022–2024: research & experimental (R&E) costs had to be capitalized – 5 years domestic, 15 years foreign. The One Big Beautiful Bill Act (signed July 4, 2025) added § 174A.
points: Domestic R&E: deductible again – tax years beginning after Dec 31, 2024

images.title: The example
head: $2.0M domestic R&E in 2025
Year-1 deduction
images.note: Demo numbers. Federal only, 21% corporate rate.

images.title: What it’s worth
images.box: Timing, not a permanent saving: under the old rule you’d deduct the rest over the next years. But cash now beats cash later.

images.title: And your *deferred taxes*?
images.text: 2022–2024: your books expensed R&D, your return capitalized it. The unamortized balance created a deferred tax asset (DTA).
points: New domestic R&E: expensed for book and tax → no new DTA
Old balance: as it’s deducted, the DTA reverses
Total tax expense barely moves – it shifts from deferred to current

images.title: Options to *check with your advisor*
points: Keep amortizing the 2022–2024 balance → DTA unwinds slowly
Accelerate: deduct the unamortized balance in 2025 – or over 2025 and 2026 → DTA reverses faster
Small businesses: the retroactive option for 2022–2024 had a July 6, 2026 deadline – ask what still applies
images.note: Elections have conditions and deadlines. Your CPA or advisor decides what fits your case.
